title: Lighting, PPFD, DLI, Photoperiod & Canopy Uniformity
description: Specialist lighting module covering measurement geometry, PPFD mapping, DLI, photoperiod, spectrum, fixture/canopy interactions and verification reporting.
learningOutcomes: Design and execute a repeatable canopy PPFD mapping plan with controlled measurement height, orientation, grid geometry and meter verification.
Calculate and interpret DLI from representative PPFD and photoperiod while explaining why equal DLI can arise from different intensity-duration combinations.
Evaluate canopy-light uniformity using distribution, range and spatial pattern rather than relying on a single average or center measurement.
Interpret photoperiod, spectrum, fixture geometry and canopy architecture as interacting lighting variables without overstating universal crop-response claims.
Produce a lighting verification report that links measurement quality, canopy distribution, operating state, crop/environment context and authorized next action.
